items.label: LADER
items.why: Alternate first-file bootstrap at $02A2. The analysed route autostarts file 2 and bypasses it.
All 63441 payload bytes match the engine hand-over snapshot at $0820–$FFF0. It includes the initial image of the generated map buffer.
Packed Time Warp loading presentation and boot program, seen before file 1 arrives. The BASIC wrapper enters the depacker at $0810.

items.label: ATG
items.why: Persistent all-time score table read into $36F7 at engine startup. The execute checkpoint at $FFD5 reported ATG on device 8, secondary 1, with caller $084C.

items.label: F
items.why: The first instructions install the LOAD handler at $CC19 via $0330/$0331. This is a disk-loader helper.
